005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007/** The base interface for complex (internally mutable) tunable objects. */
008@SuppressWarnings("PMD.ImplicitFunctionalInterface")
009public interface ComplexTunable {
010  /**
011   * Gets the tunable table type. Default is no specified table type (null).
012   *
013   * @return Table type
014   */
015  default String getTunableType() {
016    return null;
017  }
018
019  /**
020   * Publishes the tunable to the given table.
021   *
022   * <p>This function may be called when the tunable is initially published or republished during
023   * backend migration, and it must not throw. If an exception escapes, registry and backend state
024   * is not guaranteed to be restored.
025   *
026   * @param table table
027   */
028  void publishTunable(TunableTable table);
029
030  /**
031   * Updates this complex tunable.
032   *
033   * <p>This function must not throw. If an exception escapes, registry and backend state is not
034   * guaranteed to be restored.
035   */
036  default void updateTunable() {}
037
038  /**
039   * Publishes a child tunable under all currently published paths for this complex tunable.
040   *
041   * <p>If this complex tunable is not currently published, this function does nothing. Complex
042   * tunables should still publish their current children from {@link #publishTunable(TunableTable)}
043   * so backend migration and full republish operations can recreate the complete child set.
044   *
045   * @param name the child name
046   * @param tunable the child tunable
047   */
048  default void publishChildTunable(String name, TunableBase tunable) {
049    TunableRegistry.publishChild(this, name, tunable);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Publishes a child complex tunable under all currently published paths for this complex tunable.
054   *
055   * <p>If this complex tunable is not currently published, this function does nothing. Complex
056   * tunables should still publish their current children from {@link #publishTunable(TunableTable)}
057   * so backend migration and full republish operations can recreate the complete child set.
058   *
059   * @param name the child name
060   * @param tunable the child complex tunable
061   */
062  default void publishChildTunable(String name, ComplexTunable tunable) {
063    TunableRegistry.publishChild(this, name, tunable);
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Removes a child tunable from all currently published paths for this complex tunable.
068   *
069   * <p>If this complex tunable is not currently published, this function does nothing.
070   *
071   * @param name the child name
072   */
073  default void removeChildTunable(String name) {
074    TunableRegistry.removeChild(this, name);
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Marks a child tunable as locally changed.
079   *
080   * <p>Use this for child tunables published from plain member variables when the member is mutated
081   * outside of the child tunable object.
082   *
083   * <p>If this complex tunable or the child tunable is not currently published, this function does
084   * nothing.
085   *
086   * @param name the child name
087   */
088  default void setChildTunableChanged(String name) {
089    TunableRegistry.setChildChanged(this, name);
090  }
091}
